title: Google AI video ab 15 second ka, daam 30% kam #shorts
description:
AI news: Google ne Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash launch kiya. Ab AI video clip 3 se 15 second tak banti hai (pehle 10 second), aur Google ke mutabik daam 30% kam hai: 7 cent prati second, 720p video ke liye. Ek clip ko baar-baar edit kar sakte ho (background, light, mausam) bina shuru se banaye. Gemini API, AI Studio aur Google Vids me hai; Gemini app me Google AI Ultra walon ko rollout ho raha hai. Tez sports action aur complex physics par Google khud kehta hai ki kaam jaari hai.

Source (official):
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/introducing-gemini-omni-1-2-flash/

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Google.

Note: page screenshots are our own capture of the official page (key lines highlighted). The edit clip (house, sunset, rain) is our own illustration, not Google output. Synthetic voice.

Music: "Local Forecast - Elevator" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
